gaps.sentence: There isn't ___ milk left in the fridge.
gaps.explanation: In negative sentences use 'any' with uncountable nouns.

gaps.sentence: He kept ___ even though everyone had left.
Hardly ___ sat down when the phone rang.
There were so ___ complaints that the scheme was dropped.
___ spite of the traffic, we arrived on time.
She made me ___ my homework before dinner.
gaps.explanation: 'make somebody do' — bare infinitive after the object.

gaps.sentence: He asked me where I ___ bought the shoes.
gaps.explanation: Reported speech: 'Where did you buy…?' → asked where I had bought.
'Would you like…?' is the polite offer; 'Do you like' asks about a general preference.
